rubrics.justification: Describes an expanded blastocyst with thinned zona, compact ICM, and cohesive cellular TE consistent with the reported 3AA; appropriately notes limits of a static image, though it is somewhat hedged and not highly image-specific.

Integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, unexplained infertility, semen parameters, endometrial thickness, and lack of prior IVF failures well, and explains how these modify prognosis alongside embryo quality.

Overall logic is clear and conclusions are mostly supported, with a reasonable probability range tied to embryo quality and patient factors; minor inconsistency from discussing multiple possible ranges/stages before settling on one.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and aligned with IVF practice, including eSET for a good-prognosis young patient and caution against unproven add-ons; slight overreach in mentioning PGT-A after recurrent failure in a 28-year-old without stronger indication.

Provides practical next steps for transfer, luteal support, follow-up, lifestyle, and contingency planning after failure; useful but some suggestions remain somewhat generic rather than tightly case-specific.
